name: Lockora Login Shield
author: Our Plugin

sections.description:
Lockora Login Shield helps site owners improve the WordPress login experience with a branded login page, a custom login URL, and basic login attempt protection.

Phase 1 includes:

  • Login logo, colors, background image, and preset visual controls.
  • Custom login URL using WordPress rewrite rules.
  • Direct wp-login.php blocking options.
  • Failed login attempt lockouts by IP address.

This version focuses on login branding, custom login URLs, and basic login attempt protection.

License

Lockora Login Shield is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lockora-login-shield folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate lockora-login-shield from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Login Shield in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure the Login Design, Custom Login URL, and Security tabs.
  5. If you enable a custom login URL, bookmark it before logging out.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin include two-factor authentication?

No. This release focuses on branding, custom login URLs, and basic login attempt protection.

What happens on deactivation?

Rewrite rules are flushed, but settings are kept.

What happens on uninstall?

Plugin settings, lockout data, and plugin transients are deleted.
